name: Giant Lizard
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A broad, low lizard with a wedge-shaped head, pebbled olive-gray scales, four clawed feet, and a thick curling tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 358. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195022-giant-lizard
sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including moving upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Giant Octopus
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Skills Perception +4 and Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Languages none.
appearance: A mottled reddish-brown octopus with a broad mantle and coils of sucker-lined arms.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 358. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195023-giant-octopus
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. The octopus can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour out of water.
sections.Actions: Tentacles. Melee attack roll +5, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, all eight tentacles grapple it (escape DC 13). The creature is restrained until this grapple ends.
sections.Reactions: Ink Cloud (1/Day). When the octopus takes damage while underwater, it releases ink in a 10-foot cube centered on itself and moves up to its Swim Speed. The cube is heavily obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

name: Giant Rat
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency bonus +2. Skill Perception +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A stocky, shaggy brown rat with round ears, fine whiskers, and a long bare tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 358. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195025-giant-rat
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat’s allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Giant Scorpion
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages none.
appearance: An ochre scorpion with a thick segmented body, broad pincers, and a curved tail tipped with a raised stinger.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 359. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195026-giant-scorpion
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

Claw. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is grappled by one of the scorpion’s two claws (escape DC 13).

Sting. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

name: Giant Seahorse
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: An olive-gray seahorse with a narrow tubular snout, overlapping ridged plates, and a tightly coiled tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 359. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775820-giant-seahorse
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. The seahorse can breathe only underwater.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the seahorse moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, deal 11 (2d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage instead.
sections.Bonus actions: Bubble Dash. While underwater, the seahorse can move up to half its Swim Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
